name: Haul sacks at the mill
desc: Sacks from the cart to the stones, counted into your hand at the door. After five sacks Wen puts you on a small wage that comes in on its own, a coin every twenty seconds, here or away, for as long as you work for him. He rounds the sack rate up after twenty sacks, again after forty and again after eighty.
flavor: Wen pays by the sack and watches you carry every one of them.

events.text: Wen stops counting your sacks aloud. ‘You're on the books now. A small wage comes to you whether you're on my floor or not, and the sacks still pay by the sack. Nobody watches.’

name: Sort herbs at Granny Shu's
desc: Clean bundles for Shu's stall. Once you are her apprentice every sorting teaches Herb Lore as well. After twenty-five sortings she trusts you with the stock that makes two bundles.

name: Gather herbs by the stream
desc: Stems along the stream that hold a little qi; you can feel which now. One bundle more a trip after ten, and another after thirty.

name: Cut timber beyond the mill
desc: Straight lengths from beyond the mill, for a roof and racks of your own.

name: Haul freight to the ferry
desc: Freight to the ferry pays better than sacks, two coin more a load after twenty loads and again after fifty. Wen will hire a boy the day you take it, and his wage stops.
warn: The ferry road closes the sack work at the mill for good, and Wen's wage with it.

events.text: Wen takes on a boy for the sacks before you have finished saying it, and your name comes off his books. The ferry road pays better and he knows it.

name: Rest
desc: Lie down until the day's strength comes back. Vigor returns whatever you do; resting is faster, a pallet or a cot faster still. Spending Vigor on a chore does not end the rest: it keeps going until you are full again. Resting brings Life back too, from empty to full in about five minutes, and once the ridge has taught you Focus it brings that back in about eighty seconds. While Settle the breath is held, lying still teaches Composure as well.

name: A larger coin pouch
desc: Thirty coin more than a loose purse holds.

name: Apprentice to Granny Shu
title: Shu's apprentice
desc: Mornings sorting Shu's stock, Herb Lore from her corrections, a corner of her loft for your own things, and a share of what dries on her racks: a bundle every fifty seconds that comes in on its own, here or away.

events.text: Granny Shu looks at your hands rather than your face. ‘You sort faster than the last one. Come in the mornings.’ A cracked jade slip turns over in her fingers. ‘Nobody will have this. Six coin, if you are foolish.’

name: Cracked jade slip
desc: Lesser Breath-Gathering Method, leaves one, two and eight of twelve. ‘Sit as water sits. Draw the breath past the throat and let it pool below the navel. Feel for what is not air.’ Leaf eight: ‘…when the pooled breath turns, do not follow it. Wait at the turning. The rest is—’ The characters after that are chipped away.

events.text: Three leaves of twelve. The breath can be practised from what survives; the turn described on the last leaf cannot yet be made.

name: Cord, stakes and a hook
desc: Cord, stakes and a hook. Timber for a roof of your own is cut with them, and the fall at the broken channel is cleared with them. Labour can go a level further, and each level stacks another length of timber.

events.text: Headman Lu hears you bought cord and a hook before you have coiled them. ‘The fall at the channel. Ten coin and the stones are yours.’

name: Granny Shu reads the hard characters
desc: She fills in three readings the cracks obscure and will not say how she knows them. She wants five good bundles for it. Lore reaches a level further and speeds the copying.

events.text: Shu reads the cracked characters aloud without looking at them twice, then goes back to her bundles. ‘My mother had a slip like that,’ she says, and nothing else, however you ask.

name: Practise the slip's breath method
desc: Sit as water sits. Qi Sense grows, and the reservoir fills about a point a second. At the limit of what you understand, it can still fill the reservoir.
needtext: The reservoir is full and the slip says nothing more; the next character is missing.

name: Copy and compare the slip
desc: Copy each surviving character and set the strokes beside one another. Lore comes to anyone who will sit with the cracks; the stillness teaches a little Composure.
needtext: The surviving leaves have given up all they hold.

name: Circulate at the channel stones
desc: The stones in your floor hold the turn the leaf could not finish. Practice against them runs half again as fast and teaches a little Stone Sense.
needtext: This reading of the method has reached its limit.

name: Steady-attention exercise
desc: The third dusk left the turn repeatable; this is the practice built on it. Its second level leaves a trace that does not fade when you stop.
needtext: Qi Sense 3, and room left in Circulation.

events.text: The current stays where you left it when your attention loosens. A faint trace now marks the turn leaf eight breaks off at.

name: Steady the breath
desc: Qi drawn out through the limbs as strength. Each level of Qi Sense adds a point; long use adds two more. Held, it adds one to Strike in a fight.
flavor: The oldest use anyone finds for a reservoir, and still the most useful.

name: Carry the current
desc: The channel's reading of leaf eight: take the turn up and carry it. Three qi held low in the body make the next outing or sitting run half again as fast; the run spends it. Held, it adds one to Strike in a fight.
flavor: The stones taught the spacing; the body only has to keep it.
needtext: You are already holding a turn.
warn: Attuning this settles how your body reads leaf eight: as a current to carry. The hollow's reading, Settle the breath, will not take afterwards and closes for good.

events.text: You take the turn up and it stays, low in the body, like a breath you no longer have to hold. Anything you set out to do next feels shorter already.

name: Settle the breath
desc: The hollow's reading of leaf eight: let the turn down and keep still while it settles. Three qi become Composure and Lore. Held, it adds one to Guard in a fight.
flavor: Fernhollow does the work; you only stop interrupting it.
needtext: Neither Composure nor Lore has room left for it.
warn: Attuning this settles how your body reads leaf eight: as a current to let settle. The channel's reading, Carry the current, will not take afterwards and closes for good.

events.text: You let the turn down and keep still. It settles of its own accord, the way the ferns do, and when you open your eyes the loft is dimmer than it was.

name: A held turn
desc: The turn from leaf eight, held and not followed. The next timed undertaking runs half again as fast and spends it.

name: Settle the foundation
desc: Three minutes in the loft with the reconstructed method. Ten bundles burn to keep the air still; forty coin go to Wen for the days off his floor; the reservoir must be full and is not spent. Three of the four signs below say the sitting will hold. Afterwards the bank keeps up to six hours of time away.
flavor: Nothing in the loft will look any different afterwards.
needtext: A full reservoir; the slip's breath method fills it.

breakthrough.title: Lay the foundation
breakthrough.coreLabel: Circulation 2: the turn holds on its own

pointers.label: Qi Sense 3, enough to feel the reservoir fill
Both places walked: the broken channel and Fernhollow
A lean-to of your own, with a door to shut on the sitting
Two methods held attuned, which fills the mat's second place

events.text: The pooled breath turns, and returns, and turns again without being asked. Foundation. The method has room to grow in it now, and so does the road: the ferry crossing, and the outskirts of Old Ridge beyond it.
A traveller at the ferry asks after whoever cleared the fall. Headman Lu points at you without looking up.
A woman waiting for the ferry asks whether anyone still sits in Fernhollow at dusk. Granny Shu, buying salt beside her, says nobody in particular and looks at you.

name: Walk the broken channel
desc: Awkward ground and clear water. Two stones to bring home, a flow pattern, and a first feel for Stone Sense.

events.text: A flow pattern outlives the broken channel. The water took another course years ago; the qi still turns where it used to bend.

name: Clear the fall and reset the stones
desc: Headman Lu's standing bounty. Set the fallen stones back where the water wants them; it teaches Stone Sense quickly.
needtext: Cord and a hook, at the least.

events.text: Reset, the stones hum where the flow bends around them. Their spacing supplies exactly the turn the chipped leaf leaves blank.

name: Sit quietly in Fernhollow
desc: Sheltered ground up the stream. The current is faint, the sitting is easy, and the hollow teaches Composure for the sitting alone.
flavor: Ferns to the shoulder, and no wind that reaches the floor of it.

events.text: A faint current, easy to lose and easy to mistake for wanting one. It comes back whenever the hollow falls still.

name: Sit the hollow at dusk
desc: Dusk sitting, worth far more Qi Sense than the breath alone, with Composure for the stillness. The third dusk opens Circulation.
needtext: The hollow's current has become familiar and Qi Sense has no room left.

events.text: Shu smells the ferns on your sleeves the next morning. ‘Fernhollow at dusk,’ she says. ‘My husband used to sit there. He came home quieter every time.’
At the third dusk the turn can be held without being followed. The missing sentence has become an exercise.

name: Spar with the ferry hand
desc: A minute at the ferry landing with Old Tam and two blunt poles. Nothing is staked but the minute and the Life his blows take, and Life comes back on its own. Each of you swings as often as your Speed allows; a swing must find its mark past the other's Dodge, then lands for what its strike has over the other's guard. The methods you hold lend theirs. If neither falls inside the minute, Tam calls it his. The first win deepens Life by one, and every bout hardens Labour.
flavor: Tam drilled with a pole for a levy that never came, and has been waiting forty years for someone to practise on.

encounter.failureText: Tam lowers his pole and tells you to come back when the breath runs deeper.

events.text: Tam sits down on the landing steps and rubs his wrist. ‘Forty years I've waited for somebody to do that,’ he says, and he sounds pleased about it.
Tam leans his pole against the ferry post before the bout is done. ‘You've stopped practising on me,’ he says. ‘Go and find someone who can teach you something.’

name: Hayloft above Wen's barn
desc: Two spans among the rafters: a place to sleep and a place to practise. Your first address in Lowbridge.
flavor: Warm in the wrong season and loud in all of them.

name: Straw pallet
desc: Fills the place you sleep. Resting returns a quarter more.

name: A proper cot
desc: Fills the place you sleep in the lean-to. Resting returns half again as much, and Vigor comes back a little faster all day.

name: Practice mat
desc: Fills the place you practise. Breath practice runs a quarter faster, a little qi gathers on its own, Composure reaches a level further, and a second method has somewhere to be held.
flavor: Without somewhere to sit with it, you rebuild the method from memory every morning.

events.text: With the mat under you and one method held, there turns out to be room in your head for a second. It only wants something to hold.

name: Herb rack
desc: One span of lean-to floor. More bundles kept, a dried bundle more from every gathering, a few bundles that dry on it by themselves, and Herb Lore a level further.
needtext: The lean-to first; the hayloft has no floor to spare for a rack.

name: Herb plot by the door
desc: One span by the door, bedded with four bundles of cuttings from Shu's stock. Herbs come on by themselves whether you are home or not.

name: Channel stones set in the floor
desc: Two spans of floor for the four stones. They open Circulation, make the channel exercise half again as fast, let Stone Sense reach a level further, and give every level of Circulation another point of Vigor. Once set, the stones stay: they cannot be taken down, and they move house with you.
needtext: Qi Sense 3, to feel where the flow should bend.

events.text: Four stones set in the loft floor at the spacing the water taught them. The turn runs through the room now, and through you when you sit in it.

name: Lean-to
desc: Four spans against the end of Wen's barn, with a door that is yours. Its timber is cut with cord and a hook. Arrangements come with you; the hayloft closes behind you.
warn: Moving out of the hayloft closes it for good; the rafters go back to being Wen's.

events.text: You shut the lean-to's door behind you for the first time and stand there a while. In Lowbridge, a door you can shut counts as independence.

name: Strongbox
desc: One span of lean-to floor and room for fifty more coin. The hayloft never had a corner safe enough for one.
needtext: The lean-to first; the hayloft has no corner safe enough.
